distribution: Hekou, Yunnan, 110 m above sea level.
soldier: The large soldier is deep yellow in body colour, with a pair of apical hairs at the front of the labrum and four to five pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on each side. Head round, widest in the middle; labrum nearly triangular, its tip bluntly rounded; each mandible with a minute tooth-granule at the middle of its inner margin; the small tooth in front of the basal tooth of the right mandible larger than the pointed process of the basal tooth of the left mandible; postmentum raised, widest in the middle. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest. The sides of the pronotum slightly broadly rounded, the anterior margin concave in the middle, the posterolateral margins contracted, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Small soldier: body and head colour paler than in the large soldier, the antennal colour similar, the morphology of all parts similar to that of the large soldier, except that the inner margin of the basal tooth of the left mandible bears one small tooth and one minute pointed process, whereas the corresponding site in the large soldier bears only one minute pointed process.
